name: cal-com-booking
description: Embedded Cal.com booking widget (React embed) + Convex HTTP webhook receiver that mirrors bookings into a workspace-scoped table for downstream automations.

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CALCOM_USERNAME
env.description: Cal.com username (or team/event slug) rendered into the embed src.

env.name: CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret used to verify Cal.com webhook HMAC signature in convex/features/bookings/http.ts.

notes: Webhook handler lives at convex/features/bookings/http.ts and must verify HMAC via CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET before insert. Existing table name 'bookings' should be migrated to namespaced 'cal_com_booking_bookings' on consumer adoption.
